chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the milk of the stallion (father). He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is what your wife breast-feeds from your milk, and the milk of your child, (breast-fed to a) child of another, so it (brings about the) Prohibition'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of 'milk of the stallion' in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific mechanism of 'milk of the stallion' (laban al-fahl), where a man's milk is transferred to his wife or child, thereby establishing a mahram relationship akin to blood lineage. It highlights the Shia juristic view that this indirect nursing creates permanent marriage prohibitions, extending the concept of radāʿ (milk kinship) beyond direct maternal breastfeeding to include paternal transmission through the wife.
